#!/bin/bash
#flux: --job-name=DM_MiSeq
#flux: --nodes=1
#flux: --ntasks=1
#flux: --cpus-per-task=12
#flux: --mem-per-node=60G
#flux: --time=11:55:00
#flux: --output=DM_MiSeq.o%J
#flux: --mail-user=i.pang@unsw.edu.au
#flux: --mail-type=FAIL,END
# The PBS directive '-j oe' to join stdout and stderr was translated by setting only the
# --output directive, which will capture both streams by default in this configuration.
# The PBS mail trigger '-m ae' (abort, end) has been translated to '--mail-type=FAIL,END'.
# The original PBS request '-l nodes=1:ppn=1' is ambiguous. The snakemake command uses '-j 12',
# suggesting it needs 12 cores. The request has been translated to '--cpus-per-task=12' to
# provide these cores to a single-task job.

# The 'cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR' command is not needed as Flux starts jobs in the submission directory by default.


## Start python
module load python/3.8.3

# snakemake --dry-run --printshellcmds -j 12 --snakefile merge_demultiplexv4.smk
# snakemake --unlock --printshellcmds -j 12 --snakefile dm_miseq.smk

# WARNING: The following command uses 'qsub' to submit sub-jobs. This is specific to PBS/Torque.
# It has been replaced with 'flux submit'. However, the options passed to the --cluster
# command are still in PBS format. These will need to be manually converted to Flux format
# for the snakemake workflow to function correctly on a Flux system.
snakemake -j 12 --printshellcmds --snakefile dm_miseq.smk --cluster-config  cluster.json \
 --latency-wait 20 --use-envmodules \
 --cluster "flux submit --job-name={cluster.N} --nodes={cluster.nodes} --ntasks={cluster.ppn} --time={cluster.walltime} --mem-per-node={cluster.mem} --mail-user={cluster.email} --mail-type=FAIL,END --output={cluster.N}.o%J"

reasons: The directive '--ntasks=1' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--cpus-per-task=12' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--mem-per-node=60G' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--mail-user=i.pang@unsw.edu.au' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--mail-type=FAIL,END' is not a valid Flux option.
issues: The script's core functionality depends on Snakemake's ability to submit cluster jobs. The `--cluster` command has been translated from `qsub` to `flux submit`, but it's using invalid Flux options (like `--ntasks={cluster.ppn}` and `--mem-per-node={cluster.mem}`). This will cause every sub-job submitted by Snakemake to fail. The submission command within the `--cluster` argument needs to be corrected with valid Flux directives before the workflow can run.
